source.author: lucr
source.text: quid enim immortalibus atque beatis gratia nostra queat largirier emolumenti, ut nostra quicquam causa gerere aggrediantur?
source.text_original: quid enim immortalibus atque beatis / gratia nostra queat largirier emolumenti, / ut nostra quicquam causa gerere aggrediantur?
source.text_english: For what indeed could our gratitude bestow on beings immortal and blessed as an advantage, so that they should set out to do anything on our behalf?
